content_zh:
她骂的不够尽兴，丝毫没有察觉到白颜身旁降下来的温度，冷笑着说道：“不过，你和你那骚狐狸似得娘简直一个德行，都是一身的骚-劲，你先是霸占了皇子殿下，现在又干出这种伤风败俗的事情！对亲戚都能这样狠心！等你爹回来，我立刻让他将你活活打死！”
白颜唇角上扬，安静的听着于老夫人的斥责，一双冰冷的双眸中已经有杀气涌动不已。
“娘，你先别说了，”于蓉假意劝解，再对着白颜说道，“颜儿，身为亲戚，本就该互帮互助，你舅舅现在有需要，你怎能不帮？何况，你爹也不喜欢无情无义的人。”
白颜曾经最在意的便是白振祥这个父亲，每次于蓉用白振祥压她，她什么都答应。
就连让她守着在白家遭受苛刻之事，她同样也没有对外说一个字。
可是，如今的她，已经不再是之前的白颜……
“身为亲戚，应该互帮互助，这话说的没错，于家毕竟是你于蓉的亲戚，和我无关，你可以让白若或者白芷嫁过去，想必他们不想当无情无义之人。”
于蓉脸色一变，自己如此好言好语说话，她竟敢拒绝？
而且，现在用白振祥逼她，居然不奏效了？
“放肆！”于老夫人目光狰狞，“我的芷儿才十二岁而已，你竟然让一个十二岁的小丫头给六十岁老头为妾？你怎么能做出这种恶毒的事情？真的和你娘那个毒妇如出一辙！”
在老夫人的眼中，蓝月是最恶毒的人，要不是这女人，自己的女儿也不会当妾那么多年。
白颜突然想笑。
白芷才十二岁，而她，亦不是十七的碧玉之年。
让白芷为妾是恶毒，她就是理所应当？
“至于若儿……”于老夫人哼了一声，“你用什么和若儿比？她几天后就要嫁给二皇子为妃，你一个未婚先孕的女人，也敢提出让若儿给老头当妾？像你这种为了一己之私就要让你妹妹当妾的人，还有何资格当这云府的千金小姐？”
于老夫人倒打一耙的本事一直很强，白颜曾经就受教过，否则白振祥也不会宁可相信丈母娘也不相信亲生女儿。
“我再重申一遍，我白颜，断然不给人为妾！”
随着白颜的声音落下，仿若有一股压迫犹然而成，连带着整个房内的气息都有些压抑。
她的眼神如同一把利剑，冷冷的看着于蓉与于老夫人。
于蓉呼吸一滞，这臭丫头的气势什么时候变得这样强大了？

这一定是自己的幻觉，白颜只是一个废物而已！
缓了口气，于蓉拉住想要呵斥白颜的于老夫人，缓慢的站了起来，向她走去。
“白颜，今夜钱家的人就会来接你，任凭你如何不愿，你都必须当钱家老头的小妾！”她仰着头，高高在上，已然没有刚才刻意伪装的温和。

content_en:
She didn't scold her enough, and didn't notice the temperature around Bai Yan. She sneered and said, "However, you and your coquettish fox-like mother have the same virtues and are both coquettish. You first occupied His Highness the Prince, and now you do such an immoral thing! You can be so cruel to relatives! When your father comes back, I will ask him to beat you to death immediately!"
The corners of Bai Yan's lips raised, and she listened quietly to Mrs. Yu's rebuke, with murderous intent already surging in her cold eyes.
"Mom, please stop talking," Yu Rong pretended to persuade, and then said to Bai Yan, "Yan'er, as relatives, we should help each other. Your uncle is in need now, how can you not help? Besides, your father doesn't like ruthless people."
Bai Yan used to care most about her father, Bai Zhenxiang. Every time Yu Rong used Bai Zhenxiang to pressure her, she would agree to everything.
Even if she was asked to guard against the harsh things she suffered in the Bai family, she still didn't say a word to the outside world.
However, she is no longer the Baiyan she was before...
"As relatives, we should help each other. This is true. After all, the Yu family is your relative to Yu Rong and has nothing to do with me. You can let Bai Ruo or Bai Zhi marry them. I guess they don't want to be ruthless people."
Yu Rong's expression changed. She spoke so nicely, how dare she refuse?
Moreover, using Bai Zhenxiang to force her now doesn't work anymore?
"Insolent!" Mrs. Yu's eyes were ferocious, "My Zhi'er is only twelve years old, and you actually let a twelve-year-old girl be a concubine for a sixty-year-old man? How could you do such a vicious thing? You are exactly the same as that vicious woman your mother is!"
In the eyes of the old lady, Lan Yue is the most vicious person. If it weren't for this woman, her daughter would not have been a concubine for so many years.
Bai Yan suddenly wanted to laugh.
Bai Zhi is only twelve years old, and she is not seventeen years old.
It is evil to have Bai Zhi as a concubine, but she should take it for granted?
"As for Ruo'er..." Madam Yu snorted, "Why are you comparing yourself to Ruo'er? She will marry the second prince as his concubine in a few days. You, a woman who got pregnant before marriage, dare to ask Ruo'er to be the old man's concubine? A person like you who wants to make your sister a concubine for your own selfish purposes, how can you be qualified to be the daughter of the Yun Mansion?"
Madam Yu has always had a strong ability to fight against others, and Bai Yan has been taught this before, otherwise Bai Zhenxiang would not trust his mother-in-law rather than his biological daughter.
"I reiterate once again, I, Bai Yan, will never be used as a concubine!"
As Bai Yan's voice fell, there seemed to be a sense of oppression, and the atmosphere in the entire room was somewhat depressed.
Her eyes were like sharp swords, looking at Yu Rong and Mrs. Yu coldly.
Yu Rong's breath froze. When did this stinky girl become so powerful?
This must be my imagination, Bai Yan is just a waste!
After taking a breath, Yu Rong grabbed Mrs. Yu who was about to scold Bai Yan, stood up slowly, and walked towards her.
"Bai Yan, people from the Qian family will come to pick you up tonight. No matter how much you don't want to, you must be the concubine of the old man of the Qian family!" She raised her head, looking high above her, no longer as gentle as she had been pretending to be.
